subtitle.text: The crash took everything but the axe. The others made it to the evacuation point while you fell behind. Find the research campus and the cure.

ledger.text: That roar. Whatever it is, it is following you.

Research recording: The cure is an airborne agent, not a vaccine. It is harmless to healthy humans and animals, but immediately kills infected humans and animals. It never reverses infection. Carry the canister to the regional dispersal complex to release it.
